profile.name: Bhaskararao Bangaru
profile.institution: Ewha Womans University · Seoul, South Korea
profile.headline: Mechanisms. Selectivity. Molecular discovery.
profile.summary: Computational chemist investigating reaction mechanisms, asymmetric catalysis, C–H functionalization and molecular materials with quantum-chemical methods. Current interests include transition-state ensembles, molecular simulation, QM/MM, and data-driven approaches to molecular discovery.
